coach.name: Andy Bronkema
coach.since: April 2025 (hired from Ferris State, where he won a Division II national title); 2026-27 is his second season
coach.notes: Entered 2026-27 at 288-126 overall, 10-21 at CMU (6-12 MAC) per Wikipedia MAC season page. PLACED ON LEAVE Nov. 5, 2026, two days after the season-opening win at Louisiana-Monroe; CMU did not announce an explanation (CM Life, ESPN, Detroit News, ClickOnDetroit, Washington Post headlines). Associate head coach Raymoan McAfee (joined April 2025, promoted to associate HC Apr. 23, 2026) named interim head coach by AD Amy Folan. Cm-life's preview called him a 20-year coaching veteran who builds the roster year to year around a pressing, up-tempo system.

previews.title: Men's Basketball Preview: Plenty of Optimism as Bronkema Enters Year 2
previews.author: Andy Sneddon
previews.summary: Official preview stresses player development and continuity: Bronkema says fans will see 'a lot of similarities to last year's product' and that 'the full roster, one through 15, have something great to offer.' CMU went 10-21 (6-12 MAC) in 2025-26 and was 3-5 in conference games decided by six points or fewer. Phat Phat Brooks (third-leading scorer, 10th in MAC in assists) is called a budding star and Keenan Garner (18 starts) a leader. Newcomers highlighted: 7-2 Lenoir-Rhyne transfer Conrad Luczynski, 6-10 Pima CC transfer Brock Mendoza, freshman Jake Bascom and former CMU football player Travis Ambrose. No injuries mentioned.

previews.title: Preview: Chippewas pay no mind to the rankings, ready to 'run it back'
previews.author: Bar Belian
previews.projected_finish: 12th in MAC coaches poll (Bronkema says ranking doesn't matter)
previews.summary: CM Life frames the season around a 'run it back' mentality after CMU finished 10th in the MAC, one win from a four-way tie for the seventh seed, with five one-score losses. Returners played 44.6% of last year's 6,200 minutes. Four of the top six (Adley, Claerbaut, McIntire, Mullen) graduated and Jorden Brooks transferred back to Ferris State. Bronkema wants full-court pace, pressing and player freedom and names Brooks and Garner as leaders. Transfers Luczynski, Petty and Hackett are profiled; freshmen Acuff, Wrencher and Bascom are listed. Also notes the Toilet Paper Toss game moves from Western Michigan to Miami (OH).

previews.title: 2026-27 Mid-American Men's Basketball Overview
previews.author: Foster Roesti (CMU section); Kaily "KG" Godek
previews.summary: Calls 2026-27 an uphill battle with CMU aiming for one of eight MAC Tournament spots and facing what it calls the toughest schedule in the league, including a road stretch at Dayton, Pittsburgh and Notre Dame. Brooks could expand his offensive role; Garner returns as a 7.5/5.5 forward. Luczynski (fifth in Lenoir-Rhyne history in blocks) and JUCO scorer Hackett are the newcomers to watch. Notes the graduation of leading scorer Adley and top rebounder/shot-blocker Claerbaut.

storylines.headline: Head coach Andy Bronkema placed on leave two days into the season
storylines.detail: CM Life broke the news Nov. 5, 2026 (Isaac Krieger); ESPN, Detroit News, Washington Post and ClickOnDetroit followed. CMU gave no explanation. AD Amy Folan named associate head coach Raymoan McAfee interim head coach; the team beat Alma 93-50 on Nov. 6 under McAfee.

storylines.headline: Picked last, 'run it back' motivation
storylines.detail: Coaches poll placed CMU 12th. Returners led by Brooks and Garner cite five one-score losses and a near-miss at a MAC Tournament berth as motivation.

storylines.headline: Size infusion: 7-2 Luczynski and 6-10 Mendoza
storylines.detail: Bronkema called Luczynski 'the anchor in the middle' and said Mendoza's mobility will be key to lineups and rotations after losing Claerbaut.

storylines.headline: Toughest schedule in the MAC
storylines.detail: Non-conference road trips to Northern Kentucky, Dayton, Pittsburgh, Notre Dame and Arkansas; Toilet Paper Toss game shifts to Miami (OH).

storylines.headline: 2-0 start despite the turmoil
storylines.detail: Came back from 14 down to win 83-78 at Louisiana-Monroe (Nov. 2/3), then routed Alma 93-50 at home Nov. 6.

players_in_coverage.name: Durral "Phat Phat" Brooks
players_in_coverage.notes: 6-3, 205, Grand Rapids. 11.0 PPG, 3.9 APG in 2025-26; team assist leader; 10th in MAC in APG. Named team leader by Bronkema. Opener at ULM: 14 pts, game-high 6 assists in 24 min despite two early fouls; assist on Luczynski's go-ahead dunk. vs. Alma (Nov. 6): team-high 21 pts, 5 reb.

players_in_coverage.name: Jaxson Whitaker
players_in_coverage.notes: 6-4, 220, Muskegon. 18.4 MPG, six starts, second-most 3s on team at 34.5% in 2025-26. Opener: 11 pts, three 3s, team-leading steals.

players_in_coverage.name: Jalen Kampen
players_in_coverage.notes: 6-4, 185, Parchment, Mich. 13.9 MPG, 20 games off bench as freshman. Opener: three 3-pointers. vs. Alma: 9 pts.

players_in_coverage.name: Nsikan Usen

players_in_coverage.notes: 6-1, 185, Northville, Mich. Redshirted 2025-26. Scoreless in 15 min at ULM; Bronkema: 'Just give him some time to get his feet wet at this level.'

players_in_coverage.notes: 6-9, 225, West Bloomfield. Transferred from Wayne State before 2025-26. First CMU minutes in opener: 2 blocks and a 3-pointer in 4 min.

recent_news.headline: Chippewas rally from 14 down to beat Louisiana-Monroe 83-78 in opener
recent_news.detail: Brooks 14 pts/6 ast; Luczynski 14 pts/3 blk and go-ahead dunk; Garner 11 pts/10 reb; Whitaker 11 pts; Petty double figures, 6-6 FT; CMU 41.4% from three, used 11 players. Bronkema: 'some guys stepped up and made some huge plays.' (CM Life posted Nov. 3.)

recent_news.headline: Head coach Andy Bronkema placed on leave
recent_news.detail: Reported by CM Life (Isaac Krieger); no reason given by CMU. AD Amy Folan named associate head coach Raymoan McAfee interim head coach: 'Since joining our program in April 2025, Coach McAfee has built strong relationships with our student-athletes.'

recent_news.headline: CMU improves to 2-0 with 93-50 win over Alma
recent_news.detail: Home opener at McGuirk Arena, first game with Raymoan McAfee as interim head coach. Phat Phat Brooks 21 pts/5 reb; freshman Jake Bascom 15 pts/5 reb; Jalen Kampen 9 pts. Next: Youngstown State at home Nov. 10.
